import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
def run(doc, name):
    raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
    print('%-24s bytes=%7d rc=%d %.2fs out=%s %s' % (name, len(raw), p.returncode, time.time()-t, p.stdout.decode()[:70], p.stderr.decode()[:100]))

# 65 chains of 64 ASNs = 4095 links (just under bound), many rounds
for n in (65, 200):
    L = min(64, 40000//n)
    rib=[{'path': [i*70+1+j for j in range(L)], 'count': 1000} for i in range(n)]
    links = sum(len(r['path'])-1 for r in rib)
    doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],
         'queries':[{'id':'a','path':[rib[0]['path'][0], rib[0]['path'][1]],'threshold':[1,2]}]}
    run(doc,'%d chains len%d (%d links)' % (n, L, links))

# near the 4096-link bound with overlaps (many rounds, shared links)
rib=[]
base=1
# build a long ladder: 500 paths over a shared pool
pool=list(range(1,900))
import random
rng=random.Random(4)
for i in range(500):
    s=rng.randrange(0,600)
    p=pool[s:s+30]
    rib.append({'path':p,'count':rng.randint(1,1000)})
links=len({tuple(sorted((p[i],p[i+1]))) for r in rib for i in range(len(r['path'])-1)})
doc={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],'queries':[]}
run(doc,'500 overlapping len30 links=%d'%links)
EOF
